caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a decorative backrest and four straight, slightly tapered legs. The backrest is dark brown and features an intricate design with vertical slats and an urn-shaped central motif adorned with delicate scrollwork. The seat is upholstered with a fabric that has horizontal stripes in muted tones of green, blue, beige, and brown. The chair is positioned at a slight angle, allowing a clear view of three legs and the detailed construction of the back. The background is a solid, light beige color with no additional objects or patterns present. There is a small signature in the lower right corner.
title: Side Chair
